evidence_and_legal_boundaries: Visuals are illustrative navigation/reconstruction aids, not independent evidence.
Finca 8,584 is the one current controlled ETJ remate/adjudication object.
Finca 8,588 is historical Matkator property and is not presently identified as an ETJ auction object.
Matkator is the executed debtor; Aweswell is not thereby an executed debtor and its separate assets are not automatically exposed.
The Aweswell link is an economic/equity-value/control gateway, not automatic veil-piercing.
Reservation of the right to cede the remate does not establish a completed cession.
Absence of a located demand/payment route for Steps 1-3 remains 'not evidenced in the record presently located', not proof that it never occurred.
The 2021 RIC/CNMV notice cannot be used to backdate knowledge of later incentive, FEDER or public-funding records that did not then exist.
FACT -> INFERENCE -> ALLEGATION -> OPEN QUESTION remains controlling.
